scripts.//build: Three bun entry points plus the stylesheet. `bun build` does not follow `new Worker(new URL(...))` or `addModule(new URL(...))` into a chunk, so the Worker and the audio worklet are entries of their own; without them the page asks the browser for a TypeScript file that is not in dist/ and nothing runs. The page entry is built with `--production` so React ships its production build. The first step refuses a Bun older than 1.4.1: its bundler turned React's CommonJS into ESM on macOS but not on Windows (a package-name check that split paths on `/` only), so the two hosts built different main.js files and `xtask package --payload-from` refused the Windows package. CI runs the Bun of `.bun-version` on both hosts. The stylesheet is Tailwind CSS v4 compiled by its CLI from `src/styles.css`. The page's icons are copied from `public/` with `index.html`. The last step fails the build rather than publishing a bundle without a file every package ships; `build.test.ts` checks the same thing against the URL main.js actually carries.
scripts.build: bun -e "if (Bun.semver.order(Bun.version, '1.4.1') < 0) throw new Error('Bun ' + Bun.version + ' bundles React differently on Windows and macOS, so the two hosts would build different packages: upgrade to Bun 1.4.1 or newer (CI uses .bun-version)')" && tailwindcss -i src/styles.css -o dist/styles.css --minify && bun build src/app/main.ts --outdir dist --target browser --production && bun build src/worker/worker.ts --outdir dist --target browser --minify && bun build src/audio/worklet.ts --outdir dist --target browser --minify && cp public/index.html dist/ && cp public/favicon.svg dist/ && cp public/favicon-32.png dist/ && cp public/apple-touch-icon.png dist/ && bun -e "for (const f of ['main.js', 'worker.js', 'worklet.js', 'index.html', 'styles.css', 'favicon.svg', 'favicon-32.png', 'apple-touch-icon.png']) if (!Bun.file('dist/' + f).size) throw new Error('dist/' + f + ' is missing: every package ships it (xtask/src/package/layout.rs WEB_FILES)')"
scripts.//e2e: The Playwright suites (tests/*.spec.ts): Chromium and Firefox on every host, WebKit on macOS only, the installed Chrome and Edge on Windows only (tests/browsers.ts). The suite never downloads a browser; a missing one skips its row with the reason.
scripts.//paced:safari: The paced browser session (tests/pacedSession.ts) in real Safari over safaridriver, run by hand once per release, never in a tier. Needs PASSPORTSIM_DATA_ROOT on the command line; writes <root>/manual/paced-safari/safari-<date>.json. See tests/safari/pacedSafari.ts.
